A bold wrapper holding only a line break still separates the words on either side

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using HtmlToMarkdown;

var result = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.Convert("<b>Alpha</b><b><br></b><b>Beta</b>", new ConversionOptions());
Console.WriteLine(result.Content);
```
